findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: calculate_gi_bill · Private data: calculate_social_security_estimator, calculate_sgli_vs_private_insurance · Public sink: calculate_gi_bill, calculate_student_budget · Destructive: calculate_aft.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: calculate_gi_bill · Private data: calculate_social_security_estimator, calculate_sgli_vs_private_insurance · Public sink: calculate_gi_bill, calculate_student_budget · Destructive: calculate_aft

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
